reviews.evidence: Shipped Cordis host/web plugin with a project drawer, dockable panes, conversation binding, terminal/file/browser/custom windows, and an event-driven control room. README includes open/bind/create steps, three labeled screenshots, build checks, a 20-step regression gate, troubleshooting, privacy, and explicit limits.
reviews.concern: Operational guidance beyond initial project creation is brief; macOS is experimental without completed end-to-end hardware testing.

reviews.evidence: Documents shipped cost/token accounting, budgets, balances, Coding Plan integrations, Plan/API separation, peak pricing and alerts, price sync, backfill, heatmaps, and bilingual UI. Includes actionable UI paths, refresh and interpretation guidance, a concrete provider example, extensive real-instance screenshots, validation commands, persistence safeguards, fallbacks, security boundaries, and known limits.
reviews.concern: Some workflows are configuration-heavy, while estimates and integrations depend on external API precision and page structures; these limitations are explicitly disclosed.

reviews.evidence: Ships a large linked DSH ecosystem catalog organized by explicit categories, contents navigation, bilingual access, an ecosystem map, concise entry format, and contribution rules. Its own guidance supports category browsing and topic-qualified submissions.
reviews.concern: Listed projects receive no credit; the catalog gives no search/filter workflow, selection methodology, entry-level verification, tests, or troubleshooting, and its command examples are installation-oriented.

reviews.evidence: Describes a shipped Agent Skill that asks one adaptive high-leverage question at a time, separates facts, assumptions, hypotheses, and unknowns, detects contradictions and gaps, verifies available facts, synthesizes shared understanding, and continues to user-confirmed actionable criteria. It explicitly covers decisions, plans, strategies, proposals, goals, red-team review, pre-mortems, and research alignment.
reviews.concern: Beyond invoking the named step or requesting scrutiny, there is no worked interaction, sample question sequence, output template, concrete result, test evidence, troubleshooting, or failure guidance.

reviews.evidence: Ships a three-pane novel and short-drama workbench with 23 Skills, 7 Roles, live file following, safe editing, Markdown/JSONL previews, two GIF demos, and five named drama deliverables.
reviews.concern: Few task-level examples or end-to-end usage steps; reliability evidence covers compatibility, migration, credential separation, and edit protection but lacks concrete troubleshooting or validation commands.

reviews.evidence: Documents discovery and rendering for multiple wallpaper types, extensive customization, filtering, playlists, power controls, transcoding, persistence, detailed operating steps, screenshots/GIFs, performance results, fallbacks, limits, security boundaries, and verification commands.
reviews.concern: README conflicts on host-file versus localStorage persistence and on Scene-wallpaper selector support, reducing reliability confidence despite strong fallback, compatibility, and validation guidance.

reviews.evidence: Ships a local WebGPU ocean skin with four integration forms, wave/daylight/glass controls, adaptive performance and accessibility behavior, an interactive site, and four labeled GIF demonstrations. README states exact compatibility, checks, browser acceptance tests, recovery behavior, privacy, and fail-stop safeguards.
reviews.concern: Most procedural text concerns installation or integration; post-install operation and explicit use cases are largely limited to visual customization and theme scenarios.

reviews.evidence: The catalog provides categorized browsing, search/API access, topic-based incremental collection and full reconciliation, read-only static manifest/patch verification, structured PR intake, CI synchronization, and a generated directory that visibly demonstrates its catalog output.
reviews.concern: Listed plugins receive no credit, and the market, CLI, and most API implementation live in a separate repository; the README shows a homepage image and query command but no actual query response.

reviews.evidence: Ships a symlink/Junction-based master skills directory, app detection/import/linking, 41+ named agents plus a universal fallback, GitHub add/sync, app management, rules sync, and cross-device commands. README gives runnable main/add/list/sync/app/rules examples and an architecture diagram.
reviews.concern: No real terminal output or screenshot demo; reliability evidence is mostly Node/OS/link compatibility and a health-check claim, without concrete failure handling, troubleshooting, tests, validation, or security guidance.

reviews.evidence: Ships a Windows WebView2 launcher with autostart, readiness waiting, three lifecycle modes, themed remembered window, deferred DSH updates, error codes, unified logs, redacted diagnostic export, prerequisite checking, and a companion lifetime plugin. Includes light/dark screenshots and actionable diagnose, prerequisite, port-recovery, log, and mode-switch instructions.
reviews.concern: Demo evidence is limited to UI screenshots without sample diagnostics or failure output; no README-level test results or detailed compatibility matrix beyond Windows and named prerequisites.
